parameters.formDescription: Enter a ClickUp task ID. Optionally a reviewer ClickUp user ID to @-direct the draft (blank = operator).

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Production entry: called by CU Webhook Producer. Inputs: taskId + caller (reviewer_user_id, caller_username) + attribution (triggered_by, invocation_type) + triggering comment (triggering_comment_id, triggering_comment_text — what the user wrote). The Form Trigger above stays as a manual test harness.

nodes.name: Load Agent Rules
nodes.notes: Core-model step 3 (ADR-004 Docs v3): fetch the AI doc (q7wz-16892) pages with markdown content = global rules (q7wz-44812) + per-person prefs. fullResponse keeps the array as one item. onError=continueRegularOutput -> run proceeds degraded if unreachable (Build Prompt flags global_rules_missing -> WARN).

nodes.name: Build Prompt
nodes.notes: Core-model step 3 assembler: GLOBAL agent-rules (q7wz-44812) + caller's personal prefs + triggering_comment_text (what was asked) + Search + web research findings + task + ancestor context. Carries web_sources for the comment's Źródła section (ADR-035). Pure shaping (ADR-019).

nodes.name: Call Invoke Model
nodes.notes: ADR-032: onError=continueErrorOutput so LLM failures (429, timeout, etc.) route to the local error path (Reset Status on Failure -> Alert Invoke Model Failed) instead of propagating to errorWorkflow with no task context.

nodes.name: Reset Status on Failure
nodes.notes: ADR-032: clears [AI] Status agenta when Invoke Model fails — prevents task from being permanently stuck at 'W trakcie'. DELETE /field/{id} is the ClickUp API v2 way to clear a custom field value. onError=continueErrorOutput so alert fires even if reset itself fails.

value.message: Wywołanie modelu LLM nie powiodło się — agent nie ukończył zadania.
value.details: =task={{ $('Build Prompt').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; error={{ ($json.error && $json.error.message) || JSON.stringify($json.error) || 'unknown' }}; jeśli 429/cooldown: zrestartuj LiteLLM: cd /opt/haxe-agents && docker compose restart litellm

nodes.name: Alert Invoke Model Failed
nodes.notes: ADR-032: CRITICAL alert when LLM call fails. details includes the error message and the LiteLLM restart command for 429/cooldown scenarios.

nodes.name: Set Status W trakcie
nodes.notes: Item 4 (ADR-026 deterministic write): sets [AI] Status agenta -> 'W trakcie' when a run starts. onError=continueErrorOutput -> WARN; non-blocking.

nodes.name: Check Rules Loaded
nodes.notes: Side branch: WARN if the GLOBAL agent-rules doc and/or the caller's personal prefs failed to load (degradation, ADR-025).

value.message: Brak zasad agenta przy budowie promptu (globalnych i/lub osobistych).

nodes.name: Build Comment
nodes.notes: Item 2: converts the model's markdown -> ClickUp Quill-delta comment ops + an @-mention tag at the top + footer + a Źródła section from web research sources (ADR-035). Pure shaping (ADR-019); the HTTP node posts it.

nodes.name: Is @mention?
nodes.notes: True (triggering_comment_id set = @mention trigger) → reply in-thread via Post Reply. False (no triggering comment = autonomous trigger, e.g. due-date arrival) → new top-level comment via Post Draft Comment.

nodes.name: Post Reply
nodes.notes: Reply path for @mention triggers: posts agent response as a reply to the triggering comment (nested in that thread). Body ops from Build Comment — not $json, which is the routing item. onError=continueErrorOutput → Alert Reply Failed, then fallback to Post Draft Comment (new top-level comment).

value.message: Nie udało się odpowiedzieć w wątku — fallback na nowy komentarz najwyższego poziomu.

nodes.name: Alert Reply Failed
nodes.notes: WARN when replying in-thread fails. Run continues — Post Draft Comment (new top-level comment) is the fallback.

nodes.name: Post Draft Comment
nodes.notes: Core-model step 5 (ADR-027): posts agent output as a new top-level ClickUp comment. Used when: (a) no triggering comment (autonomous trigger), or (b) Post Reply failed (fallback). Body ops from Build Comment. onError=continueErrorOutput -> WARN; run still returns.

value.message: Nie udało się opublikować wersji roboczej (komentarza) na zadaniu CU.

nodes.name: Set Status Zakonczono
nodes.notes: Item 4 (ADR-026): sets [AI] Status agenta -> 'Zakończono' after the draft comment is posted. Fires from both Post Reply and Post Draft Comment success paths. onError=continueErrorOutput -> WARN; non-blocking.

value.message: Nie udało się zaktualizować pola CU '[AI] Status agenta'.

nodes.name: Sum Task Cost
nodes.notes: Authoritative task cost = SUM(agent_runs.cost_pln) for this task (ADR-024). Sums all rows (gate + research + answer) — no double-count. onError=continueErrorOutput -> failure alerts, run not killed.

nodes.name: Update CU Cost Field
nodes.notes: Writes the running total to ClickUp '[AI] Koszt akcji [PLN]' (field ca7a3874...). onError=continueErrorOutput -> WARN on failure (silent-failure guard, CLAUDE.md), run not killed.

nodes.name: Call PD Verifier
nodes.notes: Inc 4: personal-data seam, always returns false (stub). Output used by Call Search, the Haiku gate alias choice, and research routing (Bedrock-EU when true). Not refactored by ADR-035.

nodes.name: Call Search
nodes.notes: Inc 4: task comments + semantic search + Layer B access filter. Returns {task_comments, additional_context, sources_used, sources_filtered_out}.

nodes.name: Build Gate Request
nodes.notes: Builds the cheap Haiku TAK/NIE gate prompt. model_override = bedrock haiku when personal_data (GDPR), else direct haiku.

nodes.name: Research Gate
nodes.notes: Cheap Haiku gate: decides if the task needs web research. Logged via Invoke Model. onError=continueErrorOutput -> fail-open (NIE).

parameters.query:
select litellm_model, temperature, max_tokens, price_in_usd_per_1k, price_out_usd_per_1k, impact
from model_routing
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and personal_data = $2 and active = true
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

select max_research_rounds, tavily_max_results
from research_parameters
where impact in ($1, '__default__') and active = true
order by (impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Resolve Research Inputs
nodes.notes: Resolves research model (Bedrock-EU alias when PD) + depth/results from research_parameters, and builds the research-only prompt.

nodes.name: Call Research the web
nodes.notes: Runs the agentic web-search loop (self-logging). onError=continueErrorOutput -> task continues without findings on failure.
